Which statement describes the bonding in potassium chloride?
A
Two electrons are shared between two atoms.
B
Two electrons are shared between two oppositely charged ions.
C
There is a strong electrostatic attraction between electrons in two different atoms.
D
There is a strong electrostatic attraction between two oppositely charged ions.

options.label: A
options.text: Two electrons are shared between two atoms.

options.label: B
options.text: Two electrons are shared between two oppositely charged ions.

options.label: C
options.text: There is a strong electrostatic attraction between electrons in two different atoms.

options.label: D
options.text: There is a strong electrostatic attraction between two oppositely charged ions.
